answer: Use pairwise-bonus discounting: map each epoch's contribution links into a trellis, and slash the matching bonus of accounts whose funding arrives in lockstep from one source. A hollow cluster of clones looks coordinated, so its bonus collapses while a lone honest agent keeps full matching. A sybil farm must fund each fake from a separate lagoon of capital and stagger every move, paying real coordination cost per identity. Limit: genuine friends who donate together can be falsely discounted.
